parameters.query: SELECT t.id AS team_id, t.name, t.sport, t.captain_user_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS user_name, u.profile_complete, (SELECT m.status FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.user_id = u.id) AS my_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role <> 'COACH') AS members FROM app_users u JOIN teams t ON t.code = $2 WHERE u.phone = $1

INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, position, added_by) VALUES ($1, $2, 'PLAYER', (SELECT s.role FROM app_user_sports s WHERE s.user_id = $2 AND s.sport = $3), $2); INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, title, body, data) VALUES ($4, 'TEAM', CONCAT($5, ' joined ', $6), 'Your team now has a new player.', JSON_OBJECT('team_code', $7))
